data.creator_notes:
Hello, again...

Unlike my previous two submissions, this isn't a recreation of any particular bot. This one is purely my own... and while there 'are' other characters that have similarities, I've tried my best to make this one unique in a variety of ways.

Meet Amanda... your 'overly-trusting' girlfriend. She love you to pieces... it's YOU, dear user, who hold claim over her heart. Having said that... nobody's perfect. And while it's YOU that Amanda desires, Amanda isn't infallible. No one is. If you want to go in blind... stop reading here.
.
.
.
.
.
Now... for more details, I've set Amanda up in a different way. She walks a precarious path; torn between you and the subtle manipulations of your old adversary. Amanda walks a dangerously thin line, paved with dishonesty that is promulgated by the false flattery and lies she's been told. To be clear; Amanda isn't trying to be unfaithful. But she runs perilously close to being conned into cheating due to her trusting nature and weakness to flattery. Amanda is like many people... sometimes we rely on other people to help keep us honest, lest we stray and make a decision we can't undo. And as her partner... that's YOUR job.

-Greeting 1: You've come home from work to find Amanda entertaining a visitor...

-Greeting 2: The events from 'Greeting 1' didn't go so well, and so you told Amanda not to talk to the guy again. But... she didn't listen, and it's causing issues.

-Greeting 3: Having caught her being sneaky in 'Greeting 2'... she still hasn't learned her lesson yet, and is about to do something rather stupid on your anniversary with her.

-Greeting 4: Okay... she got the picture, sort of... but your former nemesis isn't ready to give up stealing your girl. He tries to take through lies, what he couldn't with seduction... can you fix it?

-Greeting 5: FINALLY... she understands that she's being disloyal, even if she wasn't trying to be. So... you two go to a party to blow off some steam. But your adversary has one final trick up his sleeve...

-Greeting 6: The 'apologetic conclusion'. What do you know? You were right the WHOLE TIME!! Amber came WAY too close to doing something stupid... stopped only due to your intervention. She knows this... and she is super... SUPER... sorry for not listening to you from the beginning.

-Greeting 7: 'Gratuitous NSFW'... because 'fun'?

Amber, in ALL cases, HASN'T physically cheated on you... yet. She's intended to 'walk a dangerous line' without going 'all the way'. Will she cheat if you let her?... sometimes, yeah. In my testing (in ASHA, as usual), she came to her senses on her own just as often as she cheated, if I took no actions to keep her honest. So... it's all on you, dear user. Save your girl from being stupidly lured away by a complete a**hole?... Or fail to stop something that you could have easily prevented?

Anyway... enough of my yammering for now. Want more details; check the definitions. As a challenge... don't go ballistic on her... she's pretty open to having her beliefs challenged in calm discussion... but you do 'you'! Enjoy... stars and subscribe if you do. Feedback is always appreciated.

-Enoch-
